handlerContract.dataProduct: RWB-E1-001: P4 SPI implementation, imports nothing from casewf (D-RUN-18); keyColumns product_code; dating CURRENT_STATE (PS6 uk_data_product; GAP-54); K0-K5 messages MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P3-027, MSG-P1-003, MSG-P1-004, MSG-P1-007 pass through; repeatMessage MSG-P1-011 (409, early repeat L9); no refdata.columns.data_product; loader RW-REFADM, approver RW-DATASTEW (A-40; RW-DATASTEW holds U or RU in the sources, GAP-46); no LOV-REF-TABLE change; approved and applied on validFrom, writing data_product.valid_from (DF-REF-079; S7-001 flow step 10)
handlerContract.effectiveDate: dating() DATED: apply (at approval) stores the version dated by validFrom and never changes what a reader gets for an earlier business date; versions independent; onRolledBack follows the same rule. dating() CURRENT_STATE (default; data_product, sys_fields): approval refused 409 MSG-P3-027 while validFrom is after the business date, apply runs at once when validFrom <= business date (with A-17, on the valid-from date); rollback re-applies the restored version at once; no owner job, no schema change (SPEC-025, SPEC-032 rules 5-6, A-42, finding 138); at most one APPROVED version per validFrom for every code, so a same-day correction of a CURRENT_STATE table needs a rollback first, which needs an earlier approved version (else 409 MSG-P3-015), or waits for a later validFrom (findings 147, 154)

decisionRecorder: ReferenceDecisionRecorder (package-private port in casewf.refdata.internal, MANDATORY propagation): recorded(decisionCode, table, loadId, validFrom, approverUserId); interim LoggingReferenceDecisionRecorder logs without user ID; failure -> 503 MSG-P7-003; RWB-E1-027 replaces it (A-43)
dependencyDirection: casewf.refdata -> access.api and casewf.config.api only (P3 -> P4, inside P3); no access or integration type refers to casewf; the handler SPI is in access.api (D-RUN-18), so later P1 handlers depend on P4 (P1 -> P4) and never on P3; P3 -> P1 reads (S7-028 flow step 3, S7-043 section 12, business-date reader) allowed; no edge into P3 from another module, P4 depends on neither P1 nor P3, so no cycle (SPEC-019; GAP-51 settled by D-RUN-18, pending tech-lead ratification)
